title: Damage Adaptation in Seconds for Architected Materials
summary: Adaptation to damages and in-situ physical repairs is essential for long-term robot autonomy, yet challenging outside of narrowly defined and well-anticipated bounds. In this work we proprioceptively adapt to catastrophic damage in soft-actuated systems in under one minute. Architected materials are well equipped for adaptation: actuator failure occurs gradually rather than acutely, and damage can be described in a low-dimensional, discrete coordinate space. Surprisingly, latent damage representations plus a simple yet robust ensemble method is sufficient for adapting to unseen damage in real-time. Moreover, we identify conditions under which exponential sample complexity collapses to linear sample complexity for learned representations of architected materials, a concrete advantage over rigid components or continuum soft mechanisms. We demonstrate LEAP, our method for adaptive proprioception, via a tracing task for a 6DoF soft wrist based on Handed Shearing Auxetic (HSA) actuators. Our algorithm is able to adapt to cuts, burns, and actuator repairs, enabling simulation-free real-time adaptation that is critical for realizing the promise of soft robots outside the lab. Videos and more information are available at https://murpheylab.github.io/leap.
tldr: This paper presents LEAP, a method that enables soft robotic systems to adapt to catastrophic damage (cuts, burns, actuator repairs) in under one minute using latent damage representations and an ensemble approach, leveraging architected materials for gradual failure and linear sample complexity.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LEAP方法，利用潜损伤表示和集成学习，使软体机器人系统能够在一分钟内适应灾难性损伤（切割、烧伤、执行器修复），利用架构材料的渐进失效特性和线性样本复杂度优势。
summary_zh: 适应损伤并进行原位物理修复对于实现长期机器人自主至关重要，但在狭义且充分预见的边界之外仍极具挑战性。在本工作中，我们利用本体感知方法，在一分钟内使软驱动系统适应灾难性损伤。结构材料具备良好的适应能力：致动器失效是逐渐而非突发性的，且损伤可在低维、离散的坐标空间中描述。令人惊讶的是，潜在损伤表征结合简单而鲁棒的集成方法足以实时适应未知损伤。此外，我们确定了结构材料学习表征中指数级样本复杂度坍缩为线性样本复杂度的条件——这相较于刚性部件或连续软体机构具有显著优势。我们通过一项基于手性剪切拉胀（HSA）致动器的六自由度软体手腕追踪任务，展示了自适应本体感知方法LEAP。该算法能够适应切割、灼伤及致动器修复，实现无需仿真的实时适应，这对于在实验室外实现软体机器人的应用前景至关重要。视频及更多信息请访问https://murpheylab.github.io/leap。

title: Agentic AI-based Framework for Mitigating Premature Diagnostic Handoff and Silent Hallucination in Healthcare Applications
summary:
Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems have driven the rise of Agentic AI, showing promise for medical reasoning. However, open-ended conversational agents remain prone to two critical failure modes: premature diagnostic handoff and silent clinical hallucinations that may go undetected before reaching the patient. In this work, we propose a multi-agent framework that addresses both issues by replacing ``LLM-as-a-judge'' routing with deterministic orchestration constraints. The framework incorporates two safety mechanisms. First, a neuro-symbolic state-tracking gate enforces completeness of the OLDCARTS clinical protocol (Onset, Location, Duration, Character, Aggravating/Alleviating factors, Radiation, Timing, and Severity) by blocking diagnostic transitions until all required dimensions are collected. Second, an epistemic uncertainty quantification (UQ) gate computes semantic entropy (H) across K=5 independent diagnostic samples to identify and intercept divergent outputs before delivery.
  We evaluate the system using simulated patient agents powered by the llama-3.1-70b-instruct model on 150 test cases. The full architecture achieves 49.3% diagnostic precision, representing an absolute improvement of 11.3 percentage points over an unconstrained baseline. Additionally, we observe a statistically significant negative correlation (r = -0.181, p < 0.05) between OLDCARTS completeness (σ) and semantic entropy (H), suggesting that structured information gathering is associated with reduced diagnostic uncertainty.
tldr: Proposes a multi-agent framework with deterministic orchestration, neuro-symbolic state-tracking for clinical protocol completeness, and entropy-based uncertainty quantification to mitigate premature diagnostic handoff and silent hallucinations in healthcare LLM agents, achieving 11.3 percentage point improvement in diagnostic precision.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种多智能体框架，通过确定性约束、神经符号状态追踪（确保OLDCARTS临床协议完整性）和基于熵的不确定性量化机制，减少医疗对话系统中的过早诊断切换和隐性幻觉问题，将诊断精度提升11.3个百分点。
summary_zh: 近年来，大语言模型与多智能体系统的进展推动了具备医学推理能力的智能体AI发展。然而，开放式对话智能体仍易出现两种关键故障模式：过早诊断移交，以及可能在接触患者前未被察觉的隐性临床幻觉。本研究提出一种多智能体框架，通过以确定性编排约束替代“LLM作为裁判”路由方式解决上述问题。该框架包含两项安全机制：第一，神经符号状态追踪门控通过阻止诊断状态转换直至所有必需维度被收集，强制完成OLDCARTS临床协议（发病、位置、持续时间、特征、加重/缓解因素、放射、时间节点与严重程度）；第二，认知不确定性量化门控计算K=5个独立诊断样本的语义熵，以在结果交付前识别并拦截发散输出。我们采用llama-3.1-70b-instruct模型驱动的模拟患者智能体，在150个测试案例上评估该系统。完整架构实现了49.3%的诊断精确度，相较于无约束基线绝对提升11.3个百分点。此外，我们观察到OLDCARTS完整性（σ）与语义熵（H）之间存在统计学显著负相关（r = -0.181，p < 0.05），表明结构化信息收集与诊断不确定性降低相关。

title: AIPatient Arena: EHR-grounded evaluation of large language models in end-to-end clinical consultation workflows
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for use in clinical consultation tasks, yet most medical evaluations remain static, single-turn, or narrowly outcome-based, limiting their ability to reflect the sequential, uncertain, and interactive nature of real-world care. Here, we propose AIPatient Arena, an EHRs-grounded evaluation framework for assessing the clinical utility of LLMs across eight dimensions of clinical competence. The framework integrates EHR data into patient-specific knowledge graphs, enabling multi-turn physician-patient interactions. We applied AIPatient Arena on a primary cohort of 437 patients and two out-of-distribution validation cohorts of 119 and 67 patients. We observe that LLMs performed well in medical interview questioning skills (QS; mean scores, 4.43-4.99/5), ethical and professional conduct (ET; 4.38-4.93/5), and clarity and transparency of clinical explanations (EX; 3.80-4.72/5). Performance was moderate in information integration (II; 3.19-4.21/5) and medication safety and justification (MS; 3.13-3.78/5), but persistent weaknesses were observed in handling of ambiguous patient responses (HR; 2.57-3.32/5), information coverage (IC; 2.08-3.02/5), and diagnostic accuracy and reasoning (Dx; 2.63-3.55/5). Process-based evaluation revealed recurrent interaction failures, including repetitive questioning, omission of past medical history, and inadequate handling of uncertainty. Richer conversational context improved diagnostic reasoning but yielded limited gains in treatment planning. These findings indicate that final-answer accuracy alone is insufficient for evaluating clinical readiness and highlight the importance of assessing how models gather, interpret, and communicate information throughout a consultation. AIPatient Arena provides an EHR-grounded framework for workflow-oriented pre-deployment evaluation of medical LLMs.
tldr: This paper introduces AIPatient Arena, an EHR-grounded multi-turn evaluation framework for LLMs in clinical consultations, revealing strengths in questioning and ethics but weaknesses in handling ambiguity and diagnostic reasoning, arguing that final-answer accuracy alone is insufficient.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了AIPatient Arena，一个基于电子健康记录的多轮对话评估框架，用于评估大语言模型在临床咨询中的表现，发现其在提问和伦理方面表现良好，但在处理模糊信息和诊断推理方面存在弱点，认为仅靠最终答案准确性不足以评估临床准备度。
summary_zh:
摘要：
大语言模型（LLMs）在临床咨询任务中的应用日益受到关注，然而多数医学评估仍停留在静态、单轮或狭隘的基于结果的分析层面，使其难以反映真实医疗场景中连续、不确定且互动的特性。为此，我们提出AIPatient Arena——一个基于电子健康记录（EHRs）的评估框架，用于从临床能力的八个维度衡量LLMs的临床实用性。该框架将EHR数据整合至患者特异性知识图谱中，实现多轮医患交互。我们在由437名患者构成的主队列以及两个分布外验证队列（分别为119名和67名患者）上应用了AIPatient Arena。我们观察到，LLMs在医学问诊技巧（QS；平均得分4.43-4.99/5）、伦理与职业操守（ET；4.38-4.93/5）以及临床解释的清晰性与透明度（EX；3.80-4.72/5）方面表现良好。信息整合（II；3.19-4.21/5）与用药安全及合理性（MS；3.13-3.78/5）方面表现中等，但处理模糊患者应答（HR；2.57-3.32/5）、信息覆盖度（IC；2.08-3.02/5）以及诊断准确性与推理（Dx；2.63-3.55/5）方面持续存在弱点。基于过程的评估揭示了重复性交互失败，包括重复提问、遗漏既往病史以及对不确定性处理不当。更丰富的对话上下文改善了诊断推理，但在治疗规划方面提升有限。这些发现表明，仅凭最终答案的准确性不足以评估临床就绪度，并凸显了评估模型在整个咨询过程中如何收集、解释和传达信息的重要性。AIPatient Arena为医学LLMs的面向工作流的部署前评估提供了一个基于EHR的框架。

title: MeiBRD: Meta-Learning Intraoperative Biomechanical Residual Deformation
summary: Accurate intraoperative liver registration is challenging due to substantial soft-tissue deformation yet sparse intraoperative measurements. Biomechanical models regularize this ill-posedness with prior knowledge but exhibit persistent prediction bias due to simplifying assumptions, while data-driven learning solutions struggle with data efficiency, generalization, and physical plausibility. We propose a hybrid registration framework that adapts a biomechanical prior using sparse intraoperative correspondences. Rather than learning a full deformation field, we learn a residual deformation function that corrects linear biomechanical predictions, modeled as a graph neural diffusion function with geometry-aware attention over the 3D liver mesh. To enable long-range information transfer of sparse observations, we take a novel perspective of sparse intraoperative measurements as \textit{context} samples where input-output pairs of the residual deformation function are fully observed, casting the problem into learning-to-learn this residual function from intraoperative context samples with feedforward meta-learners. Experiments on a deformable liver phantom dataset demonstrate improved registration accuracy and generalization compared to rigid, biomechanical, and data-driven baselines, particularly for out-of-distribution geometries and deformations.
tldr: Proposes a hybrid liver registration framework that uses meta-learning to correct biomechanical model predictions via a graph neural diffusion function, treating sparse intraoperative measurements as context samples to learn a residual deformation function efficiently.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种混合肝脏配准框架，利用元学习通过图神经扩散函数校正生物力学模型预测，将稀疏术中测量视为上下文样本，以高效学习残余变形函数。
summary_zh: 由于实质性的软组织变形和稀疏的术中测量，精确的术中肝脏配准极具挑战性。生物力学模型凭借先验知识对这种病态问题进行正则化，但因简化假设而存在持续的预测偏差，而数据驱动的学习方法在数据效率、泛化能力和物理合理性方面面临困难。我们提出了一种混合配准框架，通过利用稀疏的术中对应点来调整生物力学先验。该框架并非学习完整的变形场，而是学习一个残差变形函数来校正线性生物力学预测，该函数被建模为一种图神经扩散函数，并在三维肝脏网格上具有几何感知注意力机制。为了实现稀疏观测的长距离信息传递，我们采用了一种新颖视角：将稀疏的术中测量视为\textit{上下文}样本，其中残差变形函数的输入-输出对完全可观测，从而将问题转化为利用前馈元学习器从术中上下文样本中学习该残差函数的学习策略。在可变形肝脏体模数据集上的实验表明，与刚性配准、生物力学模型和数据驱动基线方法相比，该方法在配准精度和泛化能力上均有提升，尤其是在处理分布外几何形状和变形时表现突出。

title: Geometry-Consistent Endoscopic Representations for Image-Guided Navigation via Structured Foundation Model Adaptation
summary: Accurate vision-based navigation in monocular endoscopy is difficult due to limited depth cues, weak tissue texture, non-rigid deformation, and substantial appearance variation across domains, all of which complicate pose estimation, depth prediction, and image-to-anatomy alignment. Although recent vision foundation models have shown promise, their learned representations often remain insufficiently geometry-consistent, hindering stable feature correspondence and limiting their reliability for downstream navigation tasks. We propose a unified framework for learning geometry-consistent and domain-robust image representations for monocular endoscopy. The framework combines a synthetic data pipeline that provides accurate geometric supervision with Hierarchy-Aware Geometry-Semantic Adaptation, a structured alternative to standard LoRA that inserts low-rank adapters selectively across the transformer hierarchy and couples them with layer-wise training objectives to encourage geometric correspondence in intermediate features and semantic consistency in deeper features. Experiments on public and proprietary datasets show improved geometric and semantic representation quality, leading to better performance on downstream navigation tasks including pose estimation and monocular depth estimation. The learned representations show favorable synthetic-to-real transfer on clinical bronchoscopy and provide a useful initialization for adaptation to sinus endoscopy and colonoscopy under limited supervision. The framework also shows favorable scaling with model size and training data. These results support hierarchy-aware, geometry-guided adaptation as a practical approach for endoscopic representation learning.
tldr: This paper proposes a unified framework for learning geometry-consistent and domain-robust image representations for monocular endoscopy, combining a synthetic data pipeline with hierarchy-aware geometry-semantic adaptation (a structured alternative to LoRA) to improve pose estimation, depth prediction, and image-to-anatomy alignment, with demonstrated effectiveness on clinical bronchoscopy and transfer to other endoscopic domains.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，用于学习单目内窥镜中几何一致且领域鲁棒的图像表示，结合了合成数据流水线和层次感知几何语义适应（一种结构化的 LoRA 替代方案），以改进位姿估计、深度预测和图像与解剖结构的对齐，并在临床支气管镜检查和向其他内窥镜领域的迁移中展示了有效性。
summary_zh: 单目内窥镜中基于视觉的精准导航面临诸多挑战，包括深度线索有限、组织纹理微弱、非刚性变形以及跨领域外观显著差异，这些问题使得位姿估计、深度预测及图像与解剖结构的对齐变得复杂。尽管近期视觉基础模型展现出一定潜力，但其习得的表征往往缺乏足够的几何一致性，导致特征对应不稳定，限制了其在下游导航任务中的可靠性。我们提出了一种统一框架，用于学习单目内窥镜中几何一致且领域鲁棒的图像表征。该框架结合了提供精确几何监督的合成数据流水线，以及层级感知的几何-语义适配——一种标准LoRA的结构化替代方案，其在Transformer层级结构中选择性地插入低秩适配器，并配合逐层训练目标，以促进中间特征的几何对应和深层特征的语义一致性。在公开及专有数据集上的实验表明，该框架提升了几何与语义表征质量，进而改善了位姿估计和单目深度估计等下游导航任务的性能。习得的表征在临床支气管镜中展现出良好的合成到真实迁移能力，并为在有限监督下适配鼻窦镜和结肠镜提供了有效的初始化。该框架在模型规模与训练数据量方面也表现出良好的可扩展性。这些结果支持将层级感知、几何引导的适配作为内窥镜表征学习的一种实用方法。

title: Reasoning Text-to-Video Retrieval for Operating Room Clips via Action-Driven Digital Twins
summary: Text-to-video retrieval in operating rooms (OR) is an enabling technology for OR safety, as it allows stakeholders to retrieve and inspect recordings of specific events. However, because the most safety-critical events may not follow the common structure, to unlock its full potential text-to-video retrieval must be able to handle implicit queries that require reasoning to identify the right video (e.g., the step right before clipping). However, existing methods rely on global embeddings that cannot reason over such queries. We propose OR3, a text-to-video retrieval method that converts clips into action-driven digital twins (ActDTs), grouping concurrent subject-action-object triplets under non-overlapping temporal intervals. Moreover, rather than cross-modal matching through paired encoders, OR3 performs imagination-based retrieval where an LLM generates hypothetical ActDTs from queries. This enables intra-modal matching via a single encoder trained with ActDT-tailored hard negatives. Finally, evidence-grounded refinement revises imagined ActDTs based on discrepancies with top candidates to capture procedure-specific patterns. We construct a benchmark from MM-OR with 276 implicit queries across four reasoning categories over 386 clips from robotic knee procedures. OR3 achieves 57.6 R@1 and 77.3 R@5, outperforming the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate that OR3 enables fine-grained discrimination between visually similar OR video clips through temporal action reasoning.
tldr: OR3 proposes a text-to-video retrieval method for operating room clips that converts videos into action-driven digital twins (ActDTs) and uses an LLM to generate hypothetical ActDTs from queries, enabling intra-modal matching and reasoning over implicit events like 'the step right before clipping'.
tldr_zh: OR3 提出了一种用于手术室视频片段的文本到视频检索方法，将视频转换为动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDTs），并利用大语言模型从查询中生成假设的 ActDTs，从而实现模态内匹配和对隐含事件（如“剪断前的一步”）的推理。
summary_zh: 摘要：手术室（OR）中的文本到视频检索是一项支持手术室安全的关键技术，它使相关人员能够检索并查看特定事件的录像记录。然而，由于最关乎安全的事件可能不符合常见结构，若要充分发挥其潜力，文本到视频检索必须能够处理需要推理才能识别正确视频的隐式查询（例如，剪断操作前的那一步骤）。然而，现有方法依赖全局嵌入，无法对此类查询进行推理。我们提出OR3，一种文本到视频检索方法，它将视频片段转换为动作驱动的数字孪生（ActDTs），在非重叠时间区间内对并发的“主语-动作-宾语”三元组进行分组。此外，OR3并非通过配对编码器进行跨模态匹配，而是执行基于想象的检索，即由大型语言模型（LLM）根据查询生成假设的ActDTs。这实现了通过单一编码器（利用针对ActDT定制的困难负样本进行训练）进行模态内匹配。最后，基于证据的精炼过程根据假设ActDT与顶级候选结果之间的差异对其进行修正，以捕获手术特定的模式。我们基于MM-OR构建了一个基准测试集，包含来自机器人膝关节手术过程的386个视频片段上的276个隐式查询，涵盖四种推理类型。OR3实现了57.6%的R@1和77.3%的R@5，优于最强基线。这些结果表明，OR3能够通过时序动作推理，在视觉上相似的手术室视频片段之间实现细粒度区分。

title: Training LLMs with Reinforcement Learning over Digital Twin Representations for Reasoning-Intensive Surgical VideoQA
summary: Surgical video question answering requires multi-step reasoning across semantic, spatial, and temporal dimensions. Existing methods architecturally compress videos into discrete token representations and couple visual perception with reasoning. This approach fragments continuous spatial-temporal relationships and has been shown to restrict multi-step reasoning capabilities. We introduce a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that trains large language models (LLMs) to decouple perception from reasoning by operating over digital twin representations constructed from surgical foundation models. Additionally, we introduce hierarchical representations across frame, temporal window, and procedure levels with probabilistic uncertainty estimates. Finally, we propose a novel reward that combines format validation with accuracy assessment through clinical plausibility evaluation and uncertainty-aware calibration for training. To demonstrate the capabilities of this approach, we introduce REAL-Colon-Reason, a colonoscopic benchmark with 2000 question-answer pairs across three complexity levels. We achieve state-of-the-art performance on REAL-Colon-Reason and two existing surgical VideoQA benchmarks REAL-Colon-VQA and EndoVis18-VQA.
tldr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to decouple perception from reasoning for surgical video QA by using digital twin representations, hierarchical spatial-temporal features, and a novel reward function, achieving SOTA on colonoscopic and surgical VQA benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种强化学习框架，通过使用数字孪生表示、分层时空特征和新型奖励函数，训练LLM在外科手术视频问答中解耦感知与推理，在结肠镜和外科手术VQA基准上达到SOTA。
summary_zh: 摘要：手术视频问答需要在语义、空间和时间维度上进行多步推理。现有方法在架构上将视频压缩为离散的标记表示，并将视觉感知与推理耦合在一起。这种方法割裂了连续的空间-时间关系，且已被证明会限制多步推理能力。我们提出了一种强化学习（RL）框架，该框架训练大语言模型（LLMs）通过操作基于手术基础模型构建的数字孪生表示，将感知与推理解耦。此外，我们引入了跨帧、时间窗口和手术过程层级的分层表示，并带有概率不确定性估计。最后，我们提出了一种新的奖励函数，该函数通过临床合理性评估和基于不确定性校准的训练，将格式验证与准确性评估相结合。为展示该方法的能力，我们推出了REAL-Colon-Reason，一个包含2000个问答对、涵盖三个复杂度级别的结肠镜基准数据集。我们在REAL-Colon-Reason以及两个现有手术视频问答基准数据集REAL-Colon-VQA和EndoVis18-VQA上达到了最先进的性能。

title: When Robots Sleep: Offline Skill Consolidation for Shared-Policy Robot Learning
summary: Robots that learn over long deployments must add new skills without losing the shared policy structure that makes earlier skills reusable. We study sequential robot skill learning, where previous trajectories and task losses may be unavailable, and the deployed policy must remain a single shared controller without task-specific heads, routing, or adapters. We identify skill-coupling collapse, a failure mode in which individual skill success remains non-trivial while reliability among related skills deteriorates. We propose Sleeping Robots, a wake-sleep framework that learns each new skill during wake and consolidates the shared policy offline during sleep using compact frozen skill memories: frozen critics with unordered state buffers for reinforcement learning and frozen actor snapshots with unordered observation buffers for imitation learning. During sleep, these memories define differentiable surrogate objectives whose gradients are combined through Nash bargaining, with adaptive anchoring and local excitability for stable consolidation. On Meta-World MT5, Sleeping Robots improves average success by 64 % and pairwise reliability by x 2.0 over the strongest non-oracle baseline, and on SurgicAI it improves average success and backward transfer relative to continual imitation baselines while remaining competitive on pairwise reliability.
tldr: This paper introduces a wake-sleep framework for sequential robot skill learning that consolidates shared policies offline using frozen skill memories and Nash bargaining, preventing skill-coupling collapse. Experiments on Meta-World and a surgical robotics benchmark (SurgicAI) show significant improvements in success rate and pairwise reliability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种觉醒-睡眠框架，用于机器人技能的序贯学习，通过冻结技能记忆和纳什讨价还价在离线时巩固共享策略，防止技能耦合崩溃。在Meta-World和手术机器人基准（SurgicAI）上的实验表明，成功率和成对可靠性显著提升。
summary_zh:
摘要：
在长期部署中学习的机器人必须能够在不丢失使早期技能可复用的共享策略结构的前提下，添加新技能。我们研究序列式机器人技能学习问题，其中先前的轨迹和任务损失可能不可用，且部署的策略必须保持单一共享控制器，无需针对特定任务的头部、路由或适配器。我们识别出技能耦合崩塌这一失效模式，即单个技能的成功率仍具一定水平，但相关技能之间的可靠性却持续恶化。我们提出休眠机器人——一种唤醒-睡眠框架，在唤醒阶段学习每个新技能，并在睡眠阶段利用紧凑的冻结技能记忆离线巩固共享策略：对于强化学习采用带无序状态缓冲区的冻结评论家，对于模仿学习采用带无序观测缓冲区的冻结演员快照。在睡眠期间，这些记忆定义了可微分的替代目标函数，其梯度通过纳什谈判进行整合，并辅以自适应锚定和局部兴奋性以实现稳定的巩固。在Meta-World MT5上，休眠机器人在平均成功率上比最强非神谕基线提升64%，将成对可靠性提升2倍；在SurgicAI上，相比持续模仿基线，它改善了平均成功率和后向迁移，同时在成对可靠性上保持竞争力。

title: ProvenanceGuard: Source-Aware Factuality Verification for MCP-Based LLM Agents
summary:
Tool-using LLM agents increasingly use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to answer from heterogeneous evidence sources, including search, APIs, databases, clinical records, and formulary tools. Standard factuality metrics usually test whether an answer is supported by pooled evidence, missing a provenance-sensitive failure mode: a claim may be supported somewhere while being attributed to the wrong source. We call this cross-source conflation.
  We introduce ProvenanceGuard, a source-aware verifier for MCP-grounded answers. It consumes captured MCP traces with stable tool IDs, source IDs, and raw outputs; decomposes answers into atomic claims; routes claims to source-specific evidence; checks support with NLI and a token-alignment proxy; compares stated attribution with the routed source; and returns per-claim verdicts plus an answer-level allow/block decision. Blocked answers can be repaired with retrieval-augmented answer revision and re-verified.
  We evaluate on 281 medical-domain MCP-agent traces. A 266-trace adjudicated subset yields 2,325 LLM-assisted claim labels split by trace; 361 held-out labels are human-verified. On the 40-trace held-out split, ProvenanceGuard achieves block F1 0.802 and source accuracy 0.858 over 260 source-eligible claims, outperforming source-blind baselines that do not emit claim-to-source IDs. On a harder multi-source benchmark it reaches block F1 0.846, while source-plus-relation accuracy drops to 0.229, showing that exact source ownership remains difficult with semantically close sources. Repair-and-reverify resolves all blocked answers in the full trace set, often via conservative fallback. In 50 controlled clinical conflation probes, ProvenanceGuard detects all injected attribution swaps with no retained wrong attribution. These results show that source attribution is an independent axis for factuality verification in MCP-based agents.
tldr: ProvenanceGuard is a source-aware factuality verifier for LLM agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that detects cross-source conflation—claims supported by evidence but attributed to the wrong source—by decomposing answers into claims, routing them to source-specific evidence, and checking support and attribution; evaluated on medical-domain MCP traces, it outperforms source-blind baselines and can repair blocked answers.
tldr_zh: ProvenanceGuard 是一种面向使用模型上下文协议（MCP）的 LLM 智能体的源感知事实性验证器，能够检测“跨源混淆”问题（即声称被某证据支持但实际归因于错误来源）；通过将答案分解为原子声明、路由至对应源证据、检查支持与归因一致性，并在医学领域 MCP 轨迹上评估，性能优于无源基线，且可修复被阻止的答案。
summary_zh:
摘要：
使用工具的LLM智能体越来越多地依赖模型上下文协议（MCP）从异构证据来源（包括搜索、API、数据库、临床记录和处方工具）中获取答案。标准事实性指标通常测试答案是否得到汇总证据的支持，但忽略了一种对溯源敏感的错误模式：某个主张可能在某个来源中得到支持，却被归因到错误的来源。我们将此称为跨来源混淆。

我们提出ProvenanceGuard——一种面向MCP落地答案的、具有来源意识的验证器。它利用稳定的工具ID、来源ID和原始输出，捕获MCP运行轨迹；将答案分解为原子主张；将主张路由至特定来源的证据；通过自然语言推理（NLI）和令牌对齐代理检查支持度；比较声明的归因与路由来源；并返回每个主张的判定结果以及答案级别的允许/阻止决策。被阻止的答案可通过检索增强的答案修正进行修复并重新验证。

我们在281条医疗领域MCP智能体轨迹上进行了评估。一条包含266条轨迹的已裁定子集产生了2,325个由LLM辅助的、按轨迹划分的主张标签；其中361个保留标签经过人工验证。在40条轨迹的保留测试集中，ProvenanceGuard对260个符合来源条件的主张实现了0.802的阻塞F1值和0.858的来源准确率，优于不输出主张到来源ID的、忽视来源的基线方法。在更具挑战性的多来源基准测试中，其阻塞F1达到0.846，而来源加关系准确率下降至0.229，表明在语义相近的来源间精确确定来源归属仍然困难。通过修复与重新验证，完整轨迹集中的所有被阻止答案均得以解决，通常采用保守回退策略。在50项受控的临床混淆探测中，ProvenanceGuard检测到了所有注入的归因交换，且未保留任何错误的归因。这些结果表明，在基于MCP的智能体中，来源归因是事实性验证的一个独立维度。

title: Treatment Response Optimized Clinical Decision Support AI System via Digital Twin Simulation
summary: Clinical decision support AI systems (CDSASs) must adapt to evolving patient conditions in real-time while adhering to strict safety constraints. We present an online adaptive framework that integrates Treatment Effect (TE) estimation to quantify clinical benefits, a patient Digital Twin (DT) to simulate treatment trajectories, and Reinforcement Learning (RL) for sequential decision-making. The AI system is initially trained on historical medical records and operates in a continuous learning loop. To ensure safety, a rule-based module monitors vital signs and blocks contraindicated treatments. Cases with strong internal model disagreement are flagged for clinician review, simulated in our experiments via a pre-trained outcome model. We validate our framework using both a synthetic clinical simulator and a real-world ovarian cancer dataset from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). In both simulated and clinical settings, our method demonstrated superior effectiveness and stability in recommending treatments compared to standard computational baselines. Furthermore, the AI system maintains low latency and requires expert consultation for only a minority of cases in our experimental validation, demonstrating its potential as a safe, clinician-supervised tool for personalized medicine that continuously improves through practical use.
tldr: The paper presents an online adaptive clinical decision support AI system that integrates treatment effect estimation, patient digital twin simulation, and reinforcement learning for sequential treatment recommendations, validated on synthetic and real-world ovarian cancer data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种在线自适应临床决策支持AI系统，结合了治疗效果估计、患者数字孪生模拟和强化学习，用于序贯治疗推荐，并在合成数据和真实卵巢癌数据上进行了验证。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
临床决策支持AI系统（CDSASs）必须在遵守严格安全约束的同时，实时适应患者病情的变化。我们提出了一种在线自适应框架，该框架整合了治疗效果（TE）估计以量化临床获益、患者数字孪生（DT）以模拟治疗轨迹，以及用于序贯决策的强化学习（RL）。该AI系统最初基于历史病历进行训练，并在持续学习循环中运行。为确保安全性，一个基于规则的模块会监测生命体征并阻止禁忌治疗。对于模型内部存在强烈分歧的病例，系统会标记以供临床医生审查，实验中通过预训练的结果模型进行模拟。我们使用合成临床模拟器和来自癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）的真实卵巢癌数据集验证了该框架。在模拟和临床环境中，与标准计算基线相比，我们的方法在推荐治疗方面表现出更优的有效性和稳定性。此外，AI系统保持低延迟，且在我们的实验验证中仅需对少数病例进行专家咨询，展示了其作为一种安全、受临床医生监督的个性化医疗工具的潜力，并可通过实际使用持续改进。

title: Beyond Failure Recovery: An Engagement-Aware Human-in-the-loop Framework for Robotic Systems
summary:
Conventional human-in-the-loop approaches typically involve users only when a robot encounters failure or uncertainty, treating humans primarily as tools for improving robot performance. However, in many human-centered robotics settings, interaction should support engagement by keeping users involved in decision-making rather than limiting them to failure-driven interventions. This is particularly compelling in physical caregiving, where mobility limitations can reduce users' ability to intervene or modulate the robot's behavior in the moment. As a result, failure-driven interaction policies may relegate users to passive observers for long stretches of the task. For example, a user with mobility limitations may feel less engaged when being continuously and passively fed by a robot. At the same time, overly frequent interaction can be tiring and increase the user's workload.
  To address this trade-off, we propose Engagement-aware MPC (E-MPC), a user-engagement-aware method that plans interaction to maintain engagement while respecting a workload constraint. E-MPC leverages a user interaction dynamics model that captures how user engagement evolves as a function of both the frequency and type of interaction. Rather than requesting input only when difficulties arise during task execution, the robot proactively considers the user's preferred level of engagement throughout the task, balancing autonomy and interaction while ensuring task success. We evaluate E-MPC in simulation with several ablations and baseline comparisons. Results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across diverse user personas. In addition, we conduct a real-world user study with participants with emulated mobility limitations on a robot-assisted bite acquisition system, showing that E-MPC improves user experience while maintaining task success.
tldr: Proposes Engagement-aware MPC (E-MPC) that proactively plans human-robot interaction to sustain user engagement under workload constraints, moving beyond failure-driven interventions; validated in simulation and a robot-assisted feeding user study with emulated mobility limitations.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种名为E-MPC（基于用户参与的模型预测控制）的方法，主动规划人机交互以在保持用户参与度的同时控制工作量，突破传统仅基于失败的干预模式；在仿真和模拟行动受限用户的机器人辅助喂食实验中验证了其效果。
summary_zh:
摘要：传统的人机协同方法通常仅在机器人遇到故障或不确定性时引入用户，将人类主要视为提升机器人性能的工具。然而，在许多以人为中心的机器人应用场景中，交互应通过使用户持续参与决策来支持其投入，而非将其局限于故障驱动的干预。这在物理照护场景中尤为关键——用户的活动受限可能削弱其即时干预或调节机器人行为的能力。因此，故障驱动型交互策略可能使用户在任务的大部分时间沦为被动观察者。例如，当活动受限的用户被机器人持续被动喂食时，他们可能感到参与度下降。与此同时，过于频繁的交互又会增加用户疲劳和工作负荷。
为解决这一权衡问题，我们提出了一种感知用户参与度的交互规划方法——参与度感知模型预测控制（E-MPC）。该方法在遵守工作负荷约束的前提下规划交互以维持用户参与度。E-MPC 利用用户交互动力学模型，该模型刻画了用户参与度如何随交互频率与类型的变化而演变。不同于仅在任务执行出现困难时请求输入，机器人会主动考虑用户在整个任务中偏好的参与水平，在确保任务成功的同时实现自主性与交互的平衡。我们通过多项消融实验和基线比较在仿真中对 E-MPC 进行了评估。结果表明该方法在不同用户画像下均具有有效性。此外，我们在一个机器人辅助咬食系统中，与模拟活动受限的参与者开展了真实世界用户研究，证明 E-MPC 在保持任务成功的同时改善了用户体验。

title: Beyond Visual Cues: CoT-Enhanced Reasoning for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Semi-supervised medical image segmentation has emerged as a dominant research problem in medical image analysis, mitigating annotation scarcity by leveraging consistency regularization on unlabeled data. However, existing approaches operate predominantly via visual pattern matching, relying heavily on pixel-level similarities. This visual-centric dependency often falters in clinical scenarios characterized by the visual-semantic mismatch, where visually similar lesions warrant distinct diagnostic conclusions, thus failing to capture the underlying diagnostic logic used by experts. To address this, we move beyond visual cues and propose CERS (CoT-Enhanced Reasoning Segmentation), a framework that integrates Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning to distinguish pathologically distinct cases. Specifically, we construct a knowledge pool enriched with linguistic reasoning descriptions generated by large language models (LLMs). A semantic-aware reference selection strategy is introduced to identify historical evidence, filtering candidates first by morphology, and then refining them via CoT consistency to eliminate hard negatives. Furthermore, a multi-scale coordinate attention module (MCAM) is designed to effectively fuse this reasoning-derived context into the decoding process. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of CERS against state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in resolving boundary ambiguities and semantic inconsistencies. The code is available at https://github.com/cymasuna/CERS.
tldr: This paper proposes CERS, a semi-supervised medical image segmentation framework that integrates Chain-of-Thought reasoning from LLMs to handle visual-semantic mismatches, using a knowledge pool and multi-scale attention to fuse reasoning context.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CERS框架，将大语言模型的链式推理融入半监督医学图像分割，通过知识库和多尺度注意力处理视觉-语义不匹配问题。
summary_zh: 半监督医学图像分割已成为医学图像分析中的主导研究方向，通过利用未标注数据的一致性正则化来缓解标注稀缺问题。然而，现有方法主要依赖视觉模式匹配，严重基于像素级相似性。这种以视觉为中心的依赖在临床场景中往往失效——这些场景以视觉-语义错配为特征，视觉上相似的病变可能对应截然不同的诊断结论，从而无法捕捉专家所用的潜在诊断逻辑。为解决这一问题，我们超越视觉线索，提出CERS（思维链增强推理分割）框架，该框架集成思维链推理以区分病理学上不同的病例。具体而言，我们构建了一个知识库，其中包含由大语言模型生成的语言推理描述。引入一种语义感知的参考选择策略来识别历史证据，先通过形态学筛选候选者，再通过思维链一致性进行细化以消除困难负样本。此外，设计了一个多尺度坐标注意力模块，将这种推理衍生的上下文有效融合到解码过程中。大量实验证明了CERS相较于最先进方法的优越性，尤其在解决边界模糊性和语义不一致性方面。代码可在https://github.com/cymasuna/CERS获取。

title: WEQA: Wearable hEalth Question Answering with Query-Adaptive Agentic Reasoning
summary: Language models are remarkably capable at medical question answering, in some cases surpassing the accuracy of general physicians. However, answering questions about wearable health data remains challenging and understudied, as these ubiquitous sensors produce continuous, high-dimensional, and longitudinal data, which is non-trivial to align with text-centric distributions in LLM pretraining. The diversity of sensor modalities and user intents cannot be effectively handled by a fixed reasoning workflow or a single pretrained foundation model. To address these challenges, we propose WEQA, a query-adaptive agent framework that unifies LLM reasoning with specialized wearable analytical and modeling tools. An LLM controller is employed to synthesize execution plans and dynamically route each query to the appropriate combination of sensor analysis and pretrained models, and perform grounded response auditing with external knowledge. We also curate a benchmark spanning four open wearable datasets comprising analytic and predictive tasks in three different health domains. Experiments show that our framework is 24% more accurate than LLM and agentic baselines, and a blinded study with 12 medical experts and 8 users shows substantial gains in usefulness and clinical soundness.
tldr: WEQA proposes a query-adaptive agentic framework that combines LLM reasoning with specialized wearable analytical tools to answer questions about wearable health data, achieving 24% higher accuracy than baselines and positive expert evaluations.
tldr_zh: WEQA 提出了一种查询自适应智能体框架，将大语言模型推理与专门的可穿戴分析工具结合，用于回答关于可穿戴健康数据的问题，相比基线方法准确率提高24%，并获得了专家积极评价。
summary_zh: 语言模型在医学问答方面表现出色，在某些情况下甚至超越全科医生的准确率。然而，针对可穿戴健康数据的问答仍具挑战且研究不足，因为这些无处不在的传感器会产生连续、高维且纵向的数据，难以与大型语言模型（LLM）预训练中以文本为中心的分布对齐。固定的推理工作流或单一预训练基础模型无法有效处理传感器模态和用户意图的多样性。为解决这些问题，我们提出WEQA——一种查询自适应智能体框架，将LLM推理与专门的可穿戴分析及建模工具统一起来。该框架采用LLM控制器来合成执行计划，动态地将每条查询路由至合适的传感器分析与预训练模型组合，并借助外部知识进行有据可依的响应审计。我们还构建了一个涵盖四个公开可穿戴数据集的基准测试，涉及三个不同健康领域的分析与预测任务。实验表明，我们的框架比LLM和智能体基线方法准确率提高24%；一项由12位医学专家和8位用户参与的盲测表明，其在实用性和临床合理性方面均有显著提升。

title: Revisiting LLM Adaptation for 3D CT Report Generation: A Study of Scaling and Diagnostic Priors
summary: Recent advances in multimodal learning, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), have demonstrated strong adaptability to natural images. However, extending their use to the medical domain, particularly for volumetric (3D) images, is challenging due to high computational complexity, volumetric dependencies and the semantic gap between visual features and clinical terminology. Naively fine-tuning LLMs on limited medical data often leads to overfitting and clinical hallucination, where linguistic fluency is prioritized over clinical factuality. In this study, we investigate parameter-efficient adaptation strategies for volumetric CT report generation and introduce RAD3D-Prefix, a lightweight diagnostic-prior conditioning framework that minimizes the need for extensive parameter training. This module integrates image embeddings with multi-label diagnostic classification logits, preserving critical clinical details while bridging the semantic gap. By keeping the LLM frozen, our method requires minimal trainable parameters and mitigates the risk of overfitting on small, domain-specific datasets. Through a systematic study spanning LLMs from 96.1M to 1.6B parameters, we find that fine-tuning is most beneficial for smaller LLMs, whereas freezing larger (~1B+ LLMs and training only lightweight projection layers provides a superior trade-off between performance, generalization, and computational efficiency. Across multiple automatic metrics and a clinical reader study, RAD3D-Prefix outperforms comparable parameter-efficient baselines and demonstrates strong out-of-domain generalization while using substantially fewer trainable parameters than fully fine-tuned alternatives.
tldr: The paper proposes RAD3D-Prefix, a parameter-efficient diagnostic-prior conditioning framework for 3D CT report generation that freezes large LLMs and uses lightweight projection layers, showing that fine-tuning is beneficial for smaller LLMs while larger frozen LLMs with minimal training achieve better performance and generalization.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了RAD3D-Prefix，一种用于三维CT报告生成的参数高效诊断先验条件框架，该框架冻结大型语言模型并使用轻量级投影层，表明微调对小模型有益，而冻结大模型并仅训练少量参数可在性能和泛化上取得更好效果。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
多模态学习的最新进展，包括大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs），已展现出对自然图像的强大适应能力。然而，将其扩展到医学领域，特别是体积（3D）图像，面临高计算复杂度、体积依赖性以及视觉特征与临床术语之间的语义鸿沟等挑战。在有限的医学数据上对LLMs进行简单微调，往往会导致过拟合和临床幻觉——即语言流畅性被优先于临床事实性。在本研究中，我们探讨了用于体积CT报告生成的参数高效自适应策略，并提出了RAD3D-Prefix——一种轻量级诊断先验条件框架，可最大程度减少对大量参数训练的需求。该模块将图像嵌入与多标签诊断分类logits相结合，在弥合语义鸿沟的同时保留了关键的临床细节。通过保持LLM冻结，我们的方法仅需极少的可训练参数，并降低了在小规模领域特定数据集上过拟合的风险。通过一项涵盖参数规模从96.1M到1.6B的LLMs的系统研究，我们发现微调对较小的LLMs最为有益，而冻结较大的（约1B+）LLMs并仅训练轻量级投影层，则在性能、泛化能力和计算效率之间提供了更优的权衡。在多项自动评估指标和一项临床读者研究中，RAD3D-Prefix均优于同类参数高效基线方法，并在使用比全微调方案少得多的可训练参数的情况下，展现出强大的域外泛化能力。

title: When LLMs Analyze Scars: From Images to Clinically-Meaningful Features
summary: Medical image classification faces a fundamental dilemma: while deep learning models achieve remarkable performance at scale, real-world clinical scenarios often suffer from severe data scarcity due to annotation costs, privacy constraints, and disease rarity. This challenge is particularly pronounced in pathological scar classification, where differentiating keloids from hypertrophic scars requires subtle expert knowledge and labeled images are extremely limited. We propose a novel paradigm that repositions large language models (LLMs) as knowledge-driven feature engineers rather than end-to-end classifiers. We call this framework ScaFE (Scar Feature Engineering). Our key insight is that LLMs encode rich medical knowledge that can be externalized as executable feature extraction code, enabling the transformation of high-dimensional images into low-dimensional, clinically interpretable representations. Specifically, we prompt an LLM with established scar assessment criteria to generate deterministic Python code that extracts features aligned with clinical scoring systems such as the Vancouver Scar Scale. Our approach offers three key advantages: (1) data efficiency, achieving robust performance with limited training samples by decoupling knowledge acquisition from statistical learning; (2) privacy preservation, as raw images are processed locally without exposure to external LLMs; and (3) interpretability, through explicit features grounded in clinical reasoning. Extensive experiments on scar classification demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms end-to-end deep learning baselines or using LLMs as black-box classifiers under limited data conditions, establishing a promising direction for integrating LLMs into data-efficient and clinically transparent medical AI systems.
tldr: The paper proposes ScaFE, a framework that uses LLMs to generate feature extraction code for scar classification from images, achieving data efficiency, privacy preservation, and interpretability, outperforming deep learning baselines under limited data conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ScaFE框架，利用LLM生成特征提取代码进行疤痕图像分类，在数据有限的情况下实现了数据高效、隐私保护和可解释性，优于深度学习基线。
summary_zh: 医学图像分类面临一个根本性困境：尽管深度学习模型在大规模数据下性能卓越，但现实临床场景中，由于标注成本、隐私约束和疾病罕见性，常面临严重的数据稀缺问题。这一挑战在病理性瘢痕分类中尤为突出——区分瘢痕疙瘩与增生性瘢痕需要细微的专家知识，且标注图像极为有限。我们提出一种新范式，将大型语言模型（LLM）重新定位为知识驱动的特征工程师，而非端到端分类器。我们将该框架称为ScaFE（瘢痕特征工程）。核心洞见在于：LLM编码了丰富的医学知识，可外化为可执行的特征提取代码，从而将高维图像转化为低维、临床可解释的表征。具体而言，我们依据既定的瘢痕评估标准提示LLM，生成确定性的Python代码，提取与温哥华瘢痕量表等临床评分系统对齐的特征。该方法具备三大优势：（1）数据效率——通过将知识获取与统计学习解耦，在有限训练样本下实现稳健性能；（2）隐私保护——原始图像在本地处理，无需暴露给外部LLM；（3）可解释性——基于临床推理的显式特征。在瘢痕分类上的大量实验表明，在数据有限条件下，我们的方法持续优于端到端深度学习基线或使用LLM作为黑箱分类器的方案，为将LLM整合至数据高效且临床透明的医疗AI系统开辟了有前景的方向。

title: Toward Accessible Psychotherapy Training Using AI-Driven Interactive Patient Avatars
summary: Training psychotherapists in evidence-based interventions such as Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) requires repeated practice with meaningful feedback, yet opportunities for safe, standardized training are limited by ethical, logistical, and resource constraints. We introduce a system designed to support ACT-oriented psychotherapy training through spoken dialogue with an embodied virtual patient. The system uses large language models to simulate patient behavior conditioned on profiles derived from real therapy sessions and configurable clinical scenarios, while a separate automated evaluator provides turn-by-turn feedback on therapist responses based on established ACT fidelity criteria. Rather than aiming to replace supervision, the system is intended to support deliberate practice by enabling experimentation, reflection, and immediate feedback in low-risk settings. Expert evaluation with practicing psychologists confirmed high realism in patient behavior and demonstrated that immediate turn-by-turn ACT feedback increased therapists' awareness of intervention choices and enabled effective experimentation with alternative responses. Quantitative evaluation across 49 therapy transcripts identified GPT-4o-mini as the optimal feedback model, achieving the lowest mean absolute error (MAE = 6.12) in replicating human supervisor ACT fidelity ratings with statistically significant agreement. This work demonstrates the potential of fidelity-aware simulated patients as a scalable complement to psychotherapy training.
tldr: This paper presents a system using large language models and automated evaluators to create interactive virtual patients for Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT) training, enabling deliberate practice with turn-by-turn feedback.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个利用大语言模型和自动评估器创建交互式虚拟患者的系统，用于接纳承诺疗法（ACT）训练，支持带有逐轮反馈的刻意练习。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
在接纳与承诺疗法（ACT）等循证干预措施中培训心理治疗师，需要反复练习并获得有意义的反馈，然而，安全、标准化的培训机会受到伦理、后勤和资源限制。我们引入了一个系统，旨在通过与具身化虚拟患者的对话来支持以ACT为导向的心理治疗培训。该系统利用大语言模型模拟患者行为，其行为模式基于真实治疗会话的档案和可配置的临床场景生成；同时，一个独立的自动评估器根据既定的ACT保真度标准，对治疗师的回应提供逐轮反馈。该系统并非旨在取代督导，而是通过支持在低风险环境中进行实验、反思和即时反馈，来促进刻意练习。来自执业心理学家的专家评估确认了患者行为的高度逼真性，并表明即时的逐轮ACT反馈提升了治疗师对干预选择的觉察，并使其能够有效尝试替代回应方式。对49份治疗记录的定量评估显示，GPT-4o-mini是最优反馈模型，在复现人类督导的ACT保真度评分时实现了最低的平均绝对误差（MAE = 6.12），且具有统计学意义的显著一致性。本工作展示了具有保真度意识的虚拟患者作为心理治疗培训可扩展补充手段的潜力。
